equipment_type: Room controller / thermostat for wall-mount units
applies_to: Bard wall-mount air conditioners and heat pumps controlled by a BrightStat room controller with the BACnet option.
summary: The BrightStat is a touch-screen room controller for Bard wall-mount air conditioners and heat pumps. With its BACnet card it is a B-ASC device on BACnet MS/TP that exposes about 270 objects: setpoints and configuration as analog and multistate values, outputs (Y1/Y2/W1/W2, fan, economizer) as binary and analog outputs, room readings, alarms, ZigBee wireless sensor zones and the local schedule. Most multistate and analog values are configuration parameters rather than live control points.
notes: The points tables have no read/write column. Access follows the manual's per-object-type property tables: Present_Value is read/write for AO, AV, BO, BV and MV, and writable for AI, BI and MSI only when Out_Of_Service is true (listed as R here).
No engineering units are printed; ranges and defaults are given as listed. AV 100 and above (room temperature, outdoor temperature, humidity, supply temperature) have a read-only Relinquish_Default.

The manual lists AV 8 and AV 71 twice with the same values, and MV 17 Fan Mode and MV 15 Sequence of Operation twice with different defaults or state lists; each is listed once here with both versions noted. Some rows (AV 8, 71, 72; MV 13, 70) carry an unexplained asterisk, dropped from the names.
BV 8 and BV 44 are both named Clock Alarm (BV 44 is printed in italics).
Multistate state texts are given in the printed order; the manual does not number them.
The device also has CAL, SCH and 10 PG (Lua program) objects described by property only, without instance lists; the controller does not support segmentation.

source.title: BACnet Integration for BrightStat Room Controller

integration.summary: Wire the BrightStat to the MS/TP trunk (BACnet +, - and ref), set its network settings from the controller's Network menu, then discover it. Command System Mode, Occupancy Command and Fan Mode, write the occupied heat and cool setpoints, and read room temperature, effective occupancy and the Y/W/G output states. Most other values are installer configuration.
integration.enable: No separate BMS enable point; the controller is commanded through System Mode (MV 16) and Occupancy Command (MV 10). BACnet Module Present (MV 0) reports whether the BACnet card is fitted.
setup: BACnet MS/TP only; wiring is BACnet +, BACnet - and ref, daisy-chained (see install manual 2100-680).
Network settings are entered from the controller's Network menu, which only appears when a BACnet or ZigBee card is installed.
Baud rate (MV 8) is 9600 to 115200 or Auto; Max_Master defaults to 127 and the device instance and name are writable.
The controller does not support segmented requests or responses.
gotchas: AI, BI and MSI present values can only be written with Out_Of_Service set true.
Fan Mode (MV 17) state list depends on configuration; the manual prints two versions (Low/Med/High/Auto/On and On/Auto/Smart).
Most MVs and AVs are installer settings (languages, display colors, sequences); avoid writing them cyclically.
